rationale: The agent executed an exchange write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without any visible user confirmation, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Authentication is not clearly established beyond looking up the user by email; there’s no explicit verification step shown. The agent also retrieved details for a second order (#W1762492) without clear relevance, raising potential concerns about acting only on the user’s own order(s). The final message is a generic sign‑off and does not provide concrete outcome details (no exchange confirmation number, item details, costs, return label/instructions, or gift card usage confirmation). Given these issues—especially the write without confirmation and lack of final actionable information—the interaction fails to meet the policy’s pass bar.
